newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toepfer details EU 1997 grain estimates.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer details EU 1997 grain estimates.

text.p: The European Union grain area in 1997 should be expanded by roughly 2.5 percent to 37.2 million hectares, grain trader Alfred C Toepfer said in a monthly newsletter.
This was lower than previously estimated, it said.

Based on a yield assumption of 5.5 tonnes per hectare, which would be a repetition of last year's high average, the EU 1997 grain crop could reach 205 million tonnes after 201 million last year, Toepfer also said.

Toepfer detailed the grain area estimate as follows -- soft wheat 14.1 million ha, up nearly two percent from last year, durum 2.8 million ha, up 2.5 percent, barley 11.8 million ha, up three percent, rye unchanged at 1.35 million ha, triticale 860,000 ha, up 15 percent, maize up one or 1.5 percent at around 4.1 million ha.
The remainder of the total was made up of oats, sorghum and mixed grains.
